Subject: Re: MAP draft & eval plan — next steps for signoff

Aisha —

Thanks for the MAP you sent over yesterday. Our execs reviewed the evaluation milestones and want to confirm the final go/no-go cadence and how the paperwork will land. Two quick asks from our side: 1) we need an explicit approvals matrix (who at Redwood signs off on SLA exceptions, operational readiness, and privacy attestation) and 2) a guaranteed signature window so our procurement can schedule bank processing and start-date logistics.

Can you outline the minimum approvals path and propose a 48-hour signing window next week? Ideally the start date is the Monday after signatures. I attached our internal kickoff calendar (see stub).

Elena
CTO, Solara Systems

Attachments: kickoff_calendar.ics (attachment stub)

From: aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com

Elena / Tom —

Great questions — thanks. Summary below and next steps to lock the signature runway: 

- Approvals matrix (minimum path):
  1) Solutions approval (me) — confirms MAP completion & evaluation pass
  2) Security & legal signoff (Karthik) — SOC2/PII controls and contract redlines
  3) Finance — payment terms and invoicing schedule (we can do a single invoice or 30-day net)
  4) Customer operations acceptance (Monica) — pre-onboarding checklist and start-slot confirmation

- Proposed signature window: 2027-05-10 09:00 PT to 2027-05-11 17:00 PT (48-hour window). We will issue a DocuSign envelope at 09:00 PT on the 10th and keep it open through the 11th. If signatures clear before close of business on the 11th, we can target Monday 2027-05-17 as the live start. If you need an earlier start we can try an accelerated path on 2027-05-13 but that requires same-day signoff from Karthik and Finance.

I attached an updated MAP with explicit checkboxes for each milestone and the SLA redline we expect to propose.

Next steps: confirm the signature window and preferred start date, and I’ll loop legal to finalize the redline and share the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Solara_MAP_v3.pdf (attachment), SLA_proposed_redline.docx (attachment)

Aisha —

Appreciate the clear path. The 05/10–05/11 window works for procurement and our legal lead will be available to review redlines on the morning of 05/10. One constraint: our treasury team requires at least three business days between signature and invoice due date to process payment. Can you confirm Redwood can set invoice due at least 3 business days from signature?

We’re aiming for the 05/17 start but if everything signs earlier we’ll circle back. Karthik — will your team need additional time to process the SLA redline?

—Tom
Director of IT Ops, Solara Systems

Elena / Tom / Aisha —

Thanks — flagged a couple of small SLA items in the attached doc (response-time definitions and an emergency rollback clause). I can turn around final redlines within 24 hours of receiving confirmation we’re good to proceed with the 05/10 envelope. From a contract process perspective:

- We prefer DocuSign for signatures and a single fully-executed MSA + SOW bundle.
- Finance note: we typically do Net 30 by default; 3 business days payment lead is unusual but acceptable if Solara is authorizing prepayment terms or a specific invoice schedule. We can mark the invoice due-date to begin counting after the signature timestamp.
- Operations (Monica) will validate the start-date checklist and confirm resource allocation once the signature is finalized.

I’ll attach the redline and SOC2 checklist (redacted evidence stub).

Elena / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turn. Confirming the plan: 

1) Signature runway: DocuSign envelope will be sent 2027-05-10 09:00 PT and remain until 2027-05-11 17:00 PT.
2) Contract bundle: MSA + SOW + SLA (redline accepted pending minor Karthik edits) — one envelope, one fully executed PDF.

4) Start date: target Monday 2027-05-17 assuming signatures complete within window. Monica will send onboarding slot confirmation within 24 hours of execution.

- Elena/Tom: confirm you want the 05/10–05/11 window as-is (reply with OK) and confirm start-date preference (05/17 or earlier).
- Karthik: I’ll send the final redline to DocuSign once you sign off.

Best,
Aisha
